description: Valid HMAC-signed session token succeeds and persists state under workspace prefix
Tampered HMAC signature is rejected before S3 or Bedrock access
Stale S3 ETag triggers If-Match precondition failure and OptimisticLockError
Dev and prod workspaces store session state under isolated S3 prefixes
Bedrock ThrottlingException retries up to max_retries and returns structured throttled response when exhausted
